newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers drop, rest of Europe mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers drop, rest of Europe mostly steady.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices weakened by around $3 a tonne on Thursday, while prices in most other European ports were mixed, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fell as low as $86/$87 towards the close, although earlier trades were concluded at above $89 fob. The sharp fall of the market encouraged a few shipowners back into the market.
"We saw quite reasonable demand of at least 15,000 tonnes (in the whole of ARA)," one supplier said.
Traders said a number of players seemed to be short the barge market and might need to cover on Friday.
Hamburg prices were broadly unchanged, restoring a wider Hamburg/Rotterdam differential.
Suppliers said offers remained wide apart, enabling the most competitive to pick up delivered fuel oil at around $90 fob.
Mediterranean prices were mixed, with Spanish prices unchanged, Italian bunkers steady, while those in southern France rose.
Egyptian fuel oil bunkers softened. Port Said was dry, Alexandria subject to enquiries, but Suez had ample supplies.
